summary: Round 11 verification — password-based admin auth (signup/login/forgot/reset/me/change-password), visa-type auto-sync on PATCH /api/admin/countries, AdminAuthShell pages, refactored VisaDetail, and OTP-flow regression. Backend: 21/21 new admin-auth password tests + 54/54 prior regression (admin-dashboard + wehive backend) = 75/75 PASSING against the live preview URL. Frontend: /admin/login, /admin/signup (rejects non-allow-listed email with admin-auth-error), /admin/forgot-password (dev_link visible), /admin/reset-password all render with the documented testids. Login as admin@wehive.co.in → /admin overview, /admin/users redirects to /admin/login when unauthenticated, Sign-out clears wehive_admin_token. Admin CountriesTab edit on US shows the full new editor (Display name, Validity, Govt fees INR, Govt fees USD, Processing days, Multi-entry, Required documents textarea, Add visa type, Remove). /visa/us renders with all extracted sub-components (hero, CategoryTabs Tourist/Business/Student/Work, DocsList, FeeBreakdown, Other countries, AssistCard).

minor.issue: Carry-over from iteration_6: still raises 500 on duplicate phone (E11000) instead of a clean 409. Not retested but no fix landed in this round.

issues: data-testid=admin-forgot-dev-link is rendered, but its href attribute is empty/null (Playwright getAttribute returns None). The link text is correct but admins cannot click-to-copy the reset URL — they have to retype the token. Set href={dev_link} on the <a> in AdminForgotPassword.jsx.

POST /api/admin-auth/login wrong password → 401 with attempt counter; ≥5 wrong attempts → 429 lockout (verified, then unlocked via dev-mode reset)
POST /api/admin-auth/signup with non-allow-listed email → 403
POST /api/admin-auth/signup with admin email that already has a password → 409
POST /api/admin-auth/signup with allow-listed email → 200/409 (idempotent across re-runs)
POST /api/admin-auth/forgot-password with unknown email → 200, no dev_token (no enumeration)
POST /api/admin-auth/forgot-password with admin email → 200 + dev_mode:true + dev_token
POST /api/admin-auth/reset-password with dev_token → 200; reuse → 400 'already-used'
POST /api/admin-auth/reset-password with invalid token → 400
GET /api/admin-auth/me with admin JWT → 200, has_password=true
POST /api/admin-auth/change-password wrong current → 401, correct → 200, login with new pw works, restored
/api/admin/{metrics,users,applications,integrations,export/users.csv} all 200 with admin JWT (role=admin)

PATCH /api/admin/countries/{id} with new categories.TestTransit → public /api/countries/{id}.visa_types includes TestTransit; removing a key drops it; categories.TestTransit.fees_inr/fees_usd persisted on public endpoint
OTP flow: send-otp + verify-otp(123456) still returns token (regression)
Public /api/countries?delivery=…&documents=…&no_visa=true filters all 200 (regression)
FE: /admin/login → admin-login-form, fields, submit redirects to /admin overview with all 7 admin-nav-* tabs
FE: Unauthenticated /admin and /admin/users redirect to /admin/login
FE: /admin/signup admin-signup-form rejects evil@example.com with admin-auth-error 'This email is not authorised for admin signup'
FE: /admin/forgot-password admin-forgot-form → dev_link banner shown (admin-forgot-dev-link visible)
FE: /admin/reset-password?token=… renders admin-reset-form
FE: AdminShell Sign-out clears localStorage.wehive_admin_token and returns user to /admin/login

FE: Admin Countries tab → edit-country-us shows category-editor-* x4 (Tourist/Business/Student/Work) with Display name, Validity, Govt fees (INR), Govt fees (USD), Processing days, Multi-entry checkbox, Required documents textarea, Remove button per category, plus Add visa type

FE: /visa/us renders with CategoryTabs (Tourist/Business/Student/Work), hero ('United States b1/b2 visitor.'), DocsList, FeeBreakdown (Application/Appointment/GST/Total), AssistCard (Talk to a counsellor), MULTI-ENTRY badge

[CARRY-OVER from iter_6] Catch DuplicateKeyError in PUT /api/users/me, return 409 instead of 500.

critical_code_review_comments: admin_auth.send_reset_email_or_log returns dev_token in the API response when SMTP isn't configured. Good for dev, but the response also includes a 'note' field that explicitly says 'SMTP not configured'. Make sure this branch is dead-code in prod by gating it behind ENV=development or NODE_ENV check, otherwise a future ops change to drop SMTP would silently leak reset tokens.

ensure_seed_admin updates is_admin=true on the existing record but only sets password_hash if the user has none. If you ever need to rotate the seeded password via env, the seed will silently no-op. Consider an ADMIN_SEED_FORCE flag.
routes_admin_auth.admin_login: attempts_left calculation does an extra DB read after record_failed_attempt — could be returned from record_failed_attempt itself to avoid the round trip.

PATCH /api/admin/countries auto-syncs visa_types from categories.keys() but allows the caller to also pass visa_types in the same body — last write wins (visa_types from caller will overwrite the auto-sync result because dict iteration order). Unit test passes today only because the restore call sends both keys with consistent values. Suggest: when categories present, drop any caller-supplied visa_types before update.
AdminAuthContext stores wehive_admin_token in localStorage — XSS exposure. Move to httpOnly cookie if/when CSRF is acceptable (not blocking).

Refactor split is clean: VisaDetail 377→136, ApplicationDetail 256→152. Sub-components live under /components/visa and /components/application — good. Recommend adding PropTypes/zod validation on the props since these are now used in multiple places.

success_rate.frontend: ~96% — every documented testid/flow worked. Only nit: admin-forgot-dev-link is missing href attribute.

seed_data_creation: TestVisaTypeSync mutates country 'us' by adding categories.TestTransit and removing one category, then restores original categories+visa_types in the same test. Lockout-test re-locks the seeded admin then unlocks via dev-mode reset (resets password to original Wehive@Admin2026).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login response key is 'access_token' (not 'token'). Admin JWT carries claim role=admin. Admin token storage: localStorage.wehive_admin_token. Forgot-password in dev mode returns {dev_mode:true, dev_token, dev_link}. ADMIN_EMAILS in .env: admin@wehive.co.in, krishnakranthiteja@gmail.com. ApplicationDetail page wasn't asserted via Playwright because the seeded admin user has no applications; spawn a regular OTP user, create an application via POST /api/applications, then visit /account/applications/{id} for E2E coverage of ApplicationHero/Timeline/DocumentChecklist/ConsultantChat/WhatsNextCard. Lockout window is 15 min — if you trigger 429 on the seeded account, immediately call /forgot-password + /reset-password with dev_token to clear it (the reset endpoint clears login_attempts).
rca_of_the_issue: Minor: admin-forgot-dev-link href is null. Likely the JSX renders <a data-testid=… onClick={…}> without href={dev_link}. Fix: add href={data.dev_link} (and target=_blank rel=noopener). Reproduction: /admin/forgot-password → submit admin@wehive.co.in → inspect the rendered anchor — text shows the URL but href attribute is empty.
